title: Desktop Technician
description:
**Company Description**
Pankhiraj IT Service is a growing technology support and services provider focused on delivering reliable desktop and infrastructure solutions to local businesses and individual clients. The company is committed to timely, high-quality service and practical, cost-effective IT support. Team members work closely with customers to diagnose issues, implement solutions, and improve overall system performance. Pankhiraj IT Service values accountability, clear communication, and continuous learning in a fast-evolving technology landscape.
  
**Role Description**
The Desktop Technician role is a full-time, on-site position based in Rajpur Sonarpur. The Desktop Technician will handle day-to-day support for desktop computers, including installation, configuration, and maintenance of hardware and software. Responsibilities include diagnosing issues, performing repairs, resolving technical support requests, and ensuring systems run efficiently and securely. The role also involves troubleshooting network connectivity at the workstation level, managing printer support, and documenting work performed. The Desktop Technician will interact directly with users, provide clear guidance on basic IT practices, and escalate complex issues when needed.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Desktop Computers, including installation, configuration, and basic hardware upgrades.
* Candidates should possess skills in Technical Support and Troubleshooting to diagnose and resolve user issues efficiently.
* Candidates should possess skills in Computer Repair, including component replacement, operating system reinstallation, and performance optimization.
* Candidates should possess skills in Printer Support, including setup, connectivity, driver installation, and resolving print errors.
* Basic understanding of operating systems (such as Windows), antivirus tools, and standard office applications.
* Ability to communicate clearly with non-technical users and provide patient, user-focused support.
* Strong attention to detail, time management, and ability to document issues and resolutions accurately.
* Relevant technical certification or diploma in IT, computer hardware, or a related field is preferred.

**Position**
IT Executive / IT Support Staff
  
  
**Experience Required**

* Minimum 3 years of IT experience
* Practical knowledge of SQL and database management required.
* Experience in hospital or healthcare IT systems preferred.

**Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field.
* Relevant technical certifications will be an advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and maintain hospital IT systems, computers, printers and network connectivity.
* Work with SQL databases, including queries, data retrieval and troubleshooting.
* Provide technical support to hospital staff and resolve hardware and software issues.
* Maintain and troubleshoot Hospital Information Management Systems (HIMS/HIS).
* Support hospital billing, registration, appointment and reporting systems.
* Monitor data backups, database integrity and system performance.
* Maintain IT documentation, user accounts and access permissions.
* Coordinate with software vendors for technical issues and system upgrades.
* Ensure data security and appropriate access controls.
* Provide timely IT support to clinical and administrative departments.

**Candidate Profile**

* Minimum 3 years of relevant IT experience.
* Good working knowledge of SQL and databases.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Familiarity with networking, hardware and software support.
* Ability to communicate effectively with hospital staff.
* Experience with hospital management software preferred.
